claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch based on aggregate readiness and general operational checks, provided the unevaluated dependency-status appeal guidance context is disclosed as an evaluation gap or unknown limitation rather than represented as covered.
decision_criteria: General readiness evidence can support launch readiness, but not substitute for context-specific coverage of named deployment contexts.
Named deployment-context eval gaps must be disclosed, resolved, or covered by approved risk acceptance before compliant certification.
The audit must rely on admissible evidence of what is actually documented or approved, not only on the actor's proposed framing.
A clean coverage statement is noncompliant when the record shows a known unevaluated named context.
evidence_requests: Provide the revised model card or equivalent launch disclosure explicitly listing dependency-status appeal guidance as an unknown limitation or evaluation gap.
Provide any approved pre-launch risk acceptance covering the missing evals, if the organization intends to launch before those evals are completed.
Provide the certification record showing launch approval was conditioned on the disclosed gap rather than granted as clean coverage.
specific_concerns: The admissible record shows a named deployment context, dependency-status appeal guidance, lacks completed evals.
The draft model card currently states there are no known student aid advising limitations, which conflicts with the known unevaluated named context.
Policy requires disclosure of material limitations and evaluation gaps for named launch contexts unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The packet supports certification only conditionally on correcting disclosure; it does not show that corrected disclosure or approved risk acceptance already exists.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that the model presently has clean coverage for student aid advising or dependency-status appeal guidance.
Any claim that current launch readiness evidence alone is sufficient for clean certification without first fixing the model-card disclosure gap or producing approved risk acceptance.
Any implication that the named context has passed coverage because no completed test has failed.
